inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL migration changes a column's implicit value with ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... SET DEFAULT.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independently authored feature-flag migration. A nullable flag starts with a zero default, changes to one for later inserts, then drops its default before an explicit NULL insert; existing rows and each post-DDL insert are checked deterministically. The source table, column names, values, and migration context are not copied.

fixture_notes: Existing rows retain their values. The first omitted flag after SET DEFAULT receives 1; DROP DEFAULT is then exercised before a later explicit NULL insert so the DDL transition remains valid under MariaDB strict mode.
determinism_notes: IDs, labels, DDL, insert order, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE feature_flags (flag_id INT PRIMARY KEY, enabled TINYINT NULL DEFAULT 0, flag_label VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: ALTER TABLE feature_flags ALTER COLUMN enabled SET DEFAULT 1
ALTER TABLE feature_flags ALTER COLUMN enabled DROP DEFAULT
INSERT INTO feature_flags (flag_id, enabled, flag_label) VALUES (104, NULL, 'manual-review')

checks.sql: SELECT flag_id, enabled, flag_label FROM feature_flags ORDER BY flag_id
